question: What was the theme of the International AIDS Candlelight Memorial observed in Kohima, Nagaland?

options.text: Light the Legacy: Remember. Advance. Act.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Light the Legacy: Remember. Advance. Act.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **International AIDS Candlelight Memorial** was observed at the **College of Nursing in Kohima, Nagaland** on **May 17, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme for this year’s memorial is **“Light the Legacy: Remember. Advance. Act.”**
 
• According to **District AIDS Control Officer (DISHA), Dr. Chibenthung Kithan**, the theme reflects remembrance, hope, resilience, and responsibility.
 
• The event honours those who lost their lives to **AIDS-related illnesses** and renews the commitment to support people living with **HIV**.
 
• It symbolises solidarity, compassion, and hope while recognising the contributions of activists, healthcare workers, caregivers, and community leaders in shaping the global **HIV response**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The memorial is one of the world’s oldest and most significant community-led movements in response to **HIV and AIDS**.
 
• The observance stressed the need for collective action by governments, communities, educational institutions, families, and civil society organisations to end stigma and ensure accessible healthcare and support services for all.
 
• The role of young people was highlighted in spreading awareness, promoting empathy, encouraging safe practices, and fostering social inclusion.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Location of observance:** **College of Nursing in Kohima, Nagaland**.
 
• **Key objective:** Remembering lives lost to **HIV and AIDS** and strengthening efforts to end the epidemic.
